status: PHASE 4A PRELIMINARY STRUCTURAL LOADS / NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION OR FLIGHT CLEARANCE

aero_load_shape.note: Section vertical-force shape is normalized to unit half-wing lift, so the VSPAERO reference speed is not used as a structural load magnitude. The 4/6 degree comparison is a load-shape sensitivity check, not a maneuver-envelope solution.

structural_concept.source: Aurora_HE-1_PDR_Blueprint_Package.pdf, PDR-0.1 sheets 2-3; concept only where consistent with the current digital baseline
structural_concept.note: Brace share and angle reproduce the PDR illustrative load path only. Elastic compatibility, fitting geometry and actual brace angle are unresolved.

screening_only.note: These are parametric stress denominators, not material allowables or laminate design values.

boundary: Phase 4A computes structural load demand, not structural adequacy.
The current 110 kg gross reference and preliminary +2.5g / -1.0g PDR load factors are retained for comparison; they are not certification limits.
The aerodynamic span-load shape is current VSPAERO evidence; it is normalized and scaled to the requested load factor.
Wing structural inertia relief, gust cases, landing loads, control-surface loads and local torsion are not yet included.
Brace share is imposed from the old PDR concept and is not solved from elastic compatibility.
Cap-area sensitivity does not address compression buckling, laminate knockdowns, fatigue, joints, crippling, bearing, bondline strength or damage tolerance.
No material, spar laminate, brace line, fitting, panel joint or airframe structure is approved or promoted by this analysis.
